theme_central: A lesson in domestic ethics: from a private conversation with the Prophet to a general call to repentance, culminating in four archetypal women — two warnings, two models of piety.
sources_note: Precisely sourced structure (grokipedia, Comprehensive Exegetical Study): 1-5, 6, 7-8, 10-12.

branches.title: Correction of the Prophet, warning to the wives
branches.resume: The Prophet corrected for having forbidden what Allah made lawful; warning against division among wives.

children.t: Correction of the Prophet, warning against division among his wives

branches.title: Protecting one's family from the Fire
branches.resume: "Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is men and stones."

children.t: Protecting one's family from the Fire through education and example

branches.title: Call to repentance, struggle
branches.resume: Sincere repentance asked of the believers; command to struggle against disbelievers and hypocrites.

children.t: Sincere repentance, struggle against disbelievers and hypocrites

branches.title: Four archetypal women
branches.resume: The wives of Nuh and Lot, disbelieving despite their closeness; Asiya and Maryam, models of piety.

children.t: The wives of Nuh and Lot, disbelieving despite their closeness to prophets
Asiya, Pharaoh's wife, and Maryam: models of piety and purity
